Court No. - 74

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 27347 of 2023
Applicant :- Ankur Kumar@ Amit Katiyar

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Raj Kumar Gautam,Shreya Gupta,Vimlesh Gautam
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.
Rejoinder affidavit to the counter affidavit filed by the State, is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State-opposite party and perused the record.

3. The instant bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 440 of 2022, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 469, 471, 120-B IPC and Section 4/10 of the Uttar Pradesh Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act,
1998, Police Station Naini, District Prayagraj, during the pendency of trial.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The applicant did not appear in the examination nor did he attempt to appear as an impersonator.
He is not a member of any solver gang.
The applicant did not facilitate use of unfair means in the examination.
The name of the applicant was disclosed by the co-accused Jaibabu Tiwari in police custody.
The said statement insofar as it implicates the applicant is unreliable.
The co-accused Jaibabu Tiwari has been granted bail by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 56805 of 2022 vide order dated 13.12.2022.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 56805 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The case of the applicant is on better footing than that of co-accused Jaibabu Tiwari.

The applicant was earlier involved in Case Crime No. 1176 of 2016, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 469, 470, 471, 473, 34 IPC and Section 66, 43A, 43B of I.T.Act,
2008, Police Station Kalyanpur, District Kanpur Nagar.
In the said case he has been granted bail by this Court.
The applicant is in jail since 29.05.2023 and in case he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the said liberty.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.

6. Having regard to the submissions made above and the fact that the applicant has remained confined for almost three months and no reasonable apprehension has been brought to the fore by the State that the applicant, if enlarged on bail, would either tamper with the evidence or delay the trial or intimidate the witness, without commenting on the merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

Order Date :- 18.8.2023 Lbm/-
